idea-plugin.name: Porelo
idea-plugin.description:
Review an agent's waiting work in IntelliJ IDEA, as you would review a colleague's change: see every push that waits at Porelo's gate, read its diff in IntelliJ's own diff windows, and approve or reject it - without checking anything out, building it or running it on your computer.

The plugin reaches Porelo on this machine, in a WSL 2 distribution or on a machine over ssh, as Porelo's interface lists them, and is told within seconds when new work waits.

Documentation: how to install, connect and review.
